text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I shouldn't have read manga 
before going to bed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still... how could I possibly fall asleep 
right when they might finally get 
together... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... I'll just read one chapter 
today and go to sleep... ...Well, maybe 
two wouldn't hurt...

It seems Mejiro Dober wasn't able to get a 
good rest...
